name: Behringer
author: Tone Zone
description: Budget stompboxes inspired by Behringer gear: shiny plastic compact pedals in signature colours (drives, bass overdrive, fuzz, delays, modulation, octaver and pitch shifter, reverb, dynamics, graphic EQs), a wah, the V-Tone amp-modeling DI preamps, an acoustic DI, a tuner, an A/B switch and a multi-FX.
